name: Matsuura Takeshi
source:
A waiter at the cafe 'Jaguar'.

A cheerful and elegant man who is popular with women.
When he's wearing his waiter outfit he always acts in a soft manner and talks eloquently.
He can also be pretty clever, the type who acts when he must.
He treats [url=/c47188]Yuusuke[/url] like a younger brother.
